Russian Translation for Create Aeronautics

This project provides a full Russian translation for the Create Aeronautics mod. It replaces the original English text with Russian localization to make the mod easier to understand and more accessible for Russian-speaking players.

Features:

Translates item names, blocks, and components added by Create Aeronautics.
Translates GUI elements, tooltips, and interface text.
Translates in-game messages and descriptions related to mechanics and systems.
Improves readability and usability for players who prefer playing Minecraft in Russian.
Maintains terminology consistency with other Russian translations of Create-related mods when possible.

How this affects gameplay:
With this translation installed, Russian-speaking players can fully understand the functionality of Create Aeronautics without needing external translation tools. Players will be able to read tooltips, understand machine behavior, configure systems correctly, and explore the mod's mechanics more comfortably.


Notes:

This project only adds Russian localization and does not change gameplay mechanics.
The original Create Aeronautics mod is required to use this translation.
Translation quality will continue to improve over time with updates.

</details>
